The main takeaway from our work is that

when the pairwise root‐mean‐square deviation is used as the local distance, the dimensionality reduction is performed in a Euclidean space, but the original protein conformation space may not be Euclidean.

, for a protein conformation space with N atoms, the local distance metric should be defined based on the Euclidean distance between N‐dimensional vectors, rather than the RMSD between the 3D coordinates of N atoms.
